h1: Custom Infant Beanies for Branded Baby Gear
metaDescription: Order custom infant beanies in bulk for your brand. Soft, safe, and perfect for baby giveaways. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom infant beanies let you extend your brand into the baby market with soft, safe headwear sized for newborns and toddlers. Unlike adult styles, infant beanies use gentle acrylic or cotton blends with no small parts. They work well for hospital welcome kits, parenting events, or employee baby showers. Decorate with a small logo using embroidery or a heat transfer for a cozy, memorable giveaway that parents actually keep.
heroAltText: Custom infant beanies in soft pastel colors displayed on baby mannequins for branding
